mapper.select: /* IResidentFacilityMapper.selectResidentAptCmplexNo */ SELECT au.apt_cmplex_no FROM hshld_head hh JOIN apt_detail ad ON hh.ho_no = ad.ho_no JOIN apt_unit au ON ad.dong_no = au.dong_no WHERE hh.user_no = #{userNo} AND NVL(hh.inout_cd, 'IN') != 'OUT' AND ROWNUM = 1

/* IResidentFacilityMapper.selectFacilityStatusCardList */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT facility_no facilityNo , facility_nm facilityNm , facility_ty_cd facilityTyCd , chk_dt chkDt , chk_stts_cd chkSttsCd , chk_cn chkCn , partner_nm partnerNm , rn FROM ( SELECT f.facility_no , f.facility_nm , f.facility_ty_cd , TO_CHAR(fch.chk_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') chk_dt , fch.chk_stts_cd , fch.chk_cn , p.partner_nm , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY f.facility_no ORDER BY fch.chk_dt DESC, fch.reg_dt DESC ) rn FROM facility f LEFT JOIN facility_check_hstry fch ON f.facility_no = fch.facility_no LEFT JOIN partner p ON fch.partner_no = p.partner_no WHERE f.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} AND NVL(f.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ) WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY chk_dt DESC NULLS LAST ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 4

/* IResidentFacilityMapper.selectFacilityHistoryList */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rn , a.* FROM ( SELECT fch.fac_chk_hstry_no facChkHstryNo , f.facility_no facilityNo , f.facility_nm facilityNm , f.facility_ty_cd facilityTyCd , TO_CHAR(fch.chk_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') chkDt , fch.chk_stts_cd chkSttsCd , fch.chk_cn chkCn , fch.chk_ty_cd chkTyCd , p.partner_nm partnerNm , NVL(p.pic_nm, p.partner_nm) picNm FROM facility_check_hstry fch JOIN facility f ON fch.facility_no = f.facility_no LEFT JOIN partner p ON fch.partner_no = p.partner_no WHERE f.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} AND NVL(f.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY fch.chk_dt DESC, fch.reg_dt DESC ) a WHERE rownum <= #{endRow} ) WHERE rn >= #{startRow}

/* IResidentFacilityMapper.selectFacilityHistoryCount */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM facility_check_hstry fch JOIN facility f ON fch.facility_no = f.facility_no WHERE f.apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo} AND NVL(f.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y'
